$description: Drag and drop (library plan wave 10, foundation dnd): the distances and rates of the drag-and-drop engine (platform/utils/dnd.js) and the treatments system/dnd.css draws while something is dragged: the lifted item (the Dragged treatment's roles), the insertion line of a sortable list and the state of a drop target. Every color is an existing role.

dnd-autoscroll-edge.$description: How close to the edge of a scrolling region (or the window) the pointer comes before the region scrolls by itself while something is dragged.

dnd-autoscroll-speed.$description: The auto-scroll speed at the very edge, in CSS pixels per millisecond; it slows in proportion as the pointer moves back from the edge, and stops outside dnd-autoscroll-edge.

dnd-keyboard-step.$description: Reposition (free move): how far one arrow key moves a picked-up item (two grid steps).

dnd-keyboard-step-large.$description: Reposition (free move): how far Shift + an arrow key moves a picked-up item.

dnd-dragging-background.$description: The lifted item (the Dragged treatment): the raised surface.

dnd-dragging-shadow.$description: The lifted item (the Dragged treatment): the overlay shadow, while it follows the pointer or is picked up with the keyboard.

dnd-dragging-opacity.$description: The item while it follows the pointer: slightly transparent, so the place it will land shows through it.

dnd-dragging-z-index.$description: The lifted item stays above its neighbors while it moves.

dnd-indicator-color.$description: The insertion line of a sortable list (where the item will land): the focus ring's color, as the drop target outline.

dnd-indicator-offset.$description: How far the insertion line sits outside the item it is drawn on: in the gap between two items.

dnd-target-outline-color.$description: A drop target with an item over it that it takes: a dashed outline in the focus ring's color (the dashboard grid's drop ring).

dnd-target-outline-offset.$description: The drop target outline's distance from the target.

dnd-target-background.$description: A drop target with an item over it that it takes: the hover fill.

dnd-target-reject-outline-color.$description: A drop target with an item over it that it does not take: the outline in the danger color an invalid field's border uses (with the not-allowed pointer and an announcement, never color alone).
